name: Menhir Savant
summary: Some druids study the paths of nature’s power through the nodes and ley lines that connect standing stones and megalithic circles, learning to tap into their energies.
replacesText: Nature Sense; Wild Empathy; Woodland Stride; Trackless Step; A Thousand Faces

features.name: Spirit Sense (Sp)
features.summary: At 1st level, a menhir savant can detect the presence of undead; fey; outsiders; and astral, ethereal, or incorporeal creatures. This ability functions like detect undead , and the druid detects all of these creatures rather than trying to detect one kind. This ability replaces nature sense and wild empathy.

resourceActions.label: Begin Spirit Sense

activeEffect.name: Spirit Sense
activeEffect.description: Detect undead, fey, outsiders, and astral, ethereal, or incorporeal creatures using the detect undead procedure.

resourceActions.summary: Track the concentration duration and the feature's complete expanded creature list.

progressionProfiles.label: Spirit Sense targets

values.creatures: Undead; fey; outsiders; astral, ethereal, and incorporeal creatures

progressionProfiles.summary: All listed creature categories are detected simultaneously rather than selecting one category.

features.name: Place Magic (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a menhir savant learns to identify and tap into ley lines in different types of terrain. As a free action, she can tap into the magic of a nearby ley line and increase her caster level by +1 for 1 round. She can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom bonus. This ability replaces woodland stride and trackless step.

resourceActions.label: Tap nearby ley line

activeEffect.name: Place Magic
activeEffect.description: +1 caster level for 1 round after tapping the nearby ley line.

resourceActions.summary: Spend one of 3 + Wisdom modifier daily uses and apply the exact 1-round caster-level increase.

features.name: Walk the Lines (Su)
features.summary: At 9th level, a menhir savant can use her connection to ley lines to cast transport via plants a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom bonus.

resourceActions.label: Walk the Lines
resourceActions.summary: Spend one Wisdom-based daily use and cast transport via plants.

features.name: Empty Body (Su)
features.summary: At 13th level, a menhir savant can become ethereal as a standard action, as if using ethereal jaunt . She can remain ethereal for a number of rounds per day equal to her druid level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. This ability replaces a thousand faces.

resourceActions.label: Become ethereal

activeEffect.name: Empty Body
activeEffect.description: Become ethereal as ethereal jaunt for the selected number of rounds. The selected amount is deducted from the daily Druid-level pool.

resourceActions.summary: Choose and spend any legal number of rounds from the level-sized daily pool in one activation.

mechanicalNotes: Spirit Sense's full detection list, Place Magic uses and caster-level effect, Wisdom-based Walk the Lines uses, and variable-cost Empty Body duration are automated.
